title: Implementer prompt limits searches to code and docs
lead: From the S21 run. The Haiku implementer ran a worktree-wide rg that printed .slicer/ and decisions/ lines, which breaks the tracking rule (agents do not search tracking files). Role prompts are ork's own text (roles.prompts).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: From the S21 run. The Haiku implementer ran a worktree-wide rg that printed .slicer/ and decisions/ lines, which breaks the tracking rule (agents do not search tracking files). Role prompts are ork's own text (roles.prompts).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The implementer prompt tells the role to search only source and docs paths and never .slicer/ or decisions/.
- A prompt test checks the rule is present.
